title: Meningen over het enquetewerk en het marktonderzoek 1968
authors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (primary investigator)

descriptions: Opinions on survey research / practical use / motivations for refusal / personal experiences of being interviewed / preferences regarding subject, time of day and length of interview. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ social class/ religion/ consumption of durables/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
